source: CEO spec §9 Approval / Action Boundaries; PDF #08 §8 Approval Engine; PDF #04 §1
description: Risk policy for the Manager approval engine. External, irreversible or high-impact actions stop for explicit human approval. Expired approvals cannot be reused.

requireApproval.reason: Important external communication requires approval (CEO spec §9).
Major publishing requires approval (CEO spec §9; PDF #08 §8).
Purchases and financial commitments require approval (CEO spec §9).
Major account changes require approval (CEO spec §9).
Sensitive customer actions require approval (CEO spec §9).

autoApprove.reason: Auto-approval stays off. Internal preparation (research, drafting, analysis) is low risk and never requires approval; anything external or high impact stops.

notes: The system must never claim an action happened when it only prepared it (CEO spec §9).
